notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 3 if the additional creature is not a creature token, or 2 otherwise.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, if it was a token, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.
